result.summary: Adds the ALLOW_LIST flag to ArgsManager options and enforces via CheckArgFlags that list options are retrieved with GetArgs() while non-list options are retrieved with GetArg(). It allows combining ALLOW_STRING and ALLOW_INT with ALLOW_BOOL for arguments that take optional values, and converts callers throughout the codebase that improperly invoked single-value methods on list options. It also fixes inconsistent behavior with empty -blockfilterindex="" arguments so they are consistently rejected as errors.
result.problem: Calling single-value getters like GetArg() or IsArgSet() on multi-value list arguments is error-prone: GetArg() returns the last command-line value but the first config value in a list, and IsArgSet() can return true on an empty negated list. Additionally, -blockfilterindex="" exhibited position-dependent behavior, enabling all filters in some configurations while triggering parse errors in others.
evidence: Commit b95db49ce7 explains: 'For example GetArg will return last command line value but first config value in the list, and IsArgSet will return true even if the list is empty if the list was negated.'

Commit 7bd8fce664 notes: 'Previous behavior was inconsistent: if -blockfilterindex or -blockfilterindex="" arguments were specified they would normally enable all block filter indexes, but could also trigger "Unknown -blockfilterindex value" errors if followed by later -blockfilterindex arguments.'

PR description notes: 'Followup PRs could use the ALLOW_LIST flags for better documentation and error checking in the future. For example, #17493 builds on this to disallow conflicting config values.'
result.scope_notes: Stacked on top of unmerged PR #16545; commits up to 0b435cb8fe belong to that base. Includes a scripted-diff commit (d10df8eee1) adding ALLOW_LIST to arguments retrieved with GetArgs.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased on updated base PR #16545; the separate rpcauth parsing fix mentioned in the original description was merged separately in #30401.
result.card: Adds the ALLOW_LIST flag to ArgsManager and enforces at runtime that multi-value options are accessed via GetArgs() rather than GetArg(). This eliminates internal developer footguns where single-value accessors return inconsistent or unexpected elements from multi-value lists, and resolves position-dependent handling of empty -blockfilterindex arguments. It unblocks follow-up work in #17493 to reject ambiguous duplicate config settings. The PR is stacked on base PR #16545.

risk.why: A mistake in argument flag enforcement or parsing could throw a logic_error during startup or misparse valid node configuration parameters.
